nativeComparisonCases.description: If the Attacker uses the same Special Attack as was last used by the Defender they deal 50% less damage and the Defender becomes Passively Stun Immune for 7 seconds.
Each time the Defender receives a Stun Debuff, they reduce the Duration of further Stun Debuffs by 10%.

Special 1 deals 30% more damage and the first melee hit or instant projectile hit, such as that from a beam or psychic blast, is Unblockable. Projectiles with flight time, such as an arrow or rock, are not Unblockable.
The Defender is more likely to activate Special Attack 1.
This Defender is more likely to activate Special Attacks 1 and 2.
The Defender is more likely to activate Special Attack 2.
+125% Attack
Every 9 seconds, the Defender gains an Unstoppable Buff for 3 seconds.
Every 10 seconds, the Defender gains an Unstoppable Buff for 2 seconds.
+1000% Health
+300% Health
The Defender is Immune to Stun effects.
The Defender's Special Attacks are Passively Unblockable. This ability is not affected by Ability Accuracy.
Each time the Defender is knocked down, the Defender suffers an Armor Break Debuff, decreasing their Armor Rating by 50 for 3 seconds.

This Defender takes 60% less damage while the Attacker has no Buffs applied to them. For each Buff the Attacker has active, this damage reduction is decreased by 20% until it reaches 0%. These Buffs can be of the same type.
Every 15 second(s) the Defender gains a Power Gain Passive, granting 15% of Max Power over 8 second(s).
During the Defender's Special Attacks and just after they end, the Attacker is inflicted with a Reversed Controls Passive. Unaffected by Ability Accuracy modification.
Every 15 seconds, all of the Attacker’s Power is removed unless they are performing a Special Attack or Dodging backwards when this timer expires.
When the Attacker performs the same Combo-Ending Attack twice in a row, the attack has a 200% chance to be Auto-Blocked.
Whenever the Attacker performs a Parry, the Defender is inflicted with a non-stacking 1,000 Armor Break Debuff for 15 seconds.

Every 30 second(s), all Buffs on both Champions are Nullified. The Champion with the most Buffs Nullified this way gains a Fury Passive, increasing Attack Rating by 500% and an Unblockable Passive, both lasting for 10 second(s). When the Fury expires, the timer restarts. In the event of a tie, both Champions gain the Fury and Unblockable Passives.
The Defender takes 90% reduced damage from all sources except Special Attacks. While performing a Special Attack the Attacker gains +200% Attack Rating for each bar of Power spent.

At the start of the fight, and whenever the Defender is struck with the first hit of a Heavy Attack, they gain an indefinite Unblockable Buff. Whenever they are knocked down by a Special Attack, they gain an Unstoppable Buff. Gaining one of these Buffs removes the other one.

At the start of the fight the Defender takes no damage from any source and instead stores it in a Damage Battery. Whenever the Defender is knocked down by a Special Attack, the Battery is emptied and the Defender immediately takes 200% of the damage stored. Whenever the Attacker is knocked down, the Battery is emptied and the Attacker takes 100% of the damage stored.
The effects of Quest and Battlegrounds Nodes cannot have their Ability Accuracy modified.
The Defender starts the fight with 7 indefinite Cruelty Passives, each increasing Critical Damage Rating by 20%. Interrupting the Defender's Heavy Attack transfers 1 Cruelty Passive to the Attacker.
When the Attacker activates a Special Attack, the Defender is inflicted with a Heal Block and an Armor Break Debuff reducing Armor Rating by 35%, each lasting 10 seconds.
The maximum allowed distance between Champions is reduced by 50%.

The Defender starts the fight with an indefinite Brace Passive. Interrupting their Heavy Attack disables it for 16 seconds, paused during the Attacker's Special and Heavy Attacks. Not affected by Ability Accuracy.

While the Defender is Dashing forwards and during their first Light or Medium Attack in a combo, they are Immune to Stun Debuffs. When the Attacker performs a Well-Timed Block, this Immunity goes on cooldown for 8 seconds.

Whenever the Attacker Dodges an Attack, both Champions are inflicted with a Heal Block Debuff, a Taunt Debuff lowering their Attack Rating by 10%, and a Disorient Debuff reducing their Defensive Ability Accuracy and Block Proficiency by 10%. These Debuffs last for 7 seconds.
Whenever the Attacker lands the same type of Basic Attack twice in a row, they gain a Placebo Buff for 5 seconds.

When the Defender reaches 20 Clairvoyance Charges they are immediately removed and replaced with Death Touch, lasting indefinitely. Death Touch is not affected by Ability Accuracy reduction and can only stack 1 time.
Every 25 seconds the Attacker is Passively Rooted for 4 seconds unless they are performing a Special Attack when the timer expires.
Whenever the Attacker performs a Parry, they gain a non-stacking Power Gain Buff, granting 50% of a Bar of Power over 5 seconds.
Whenever the Attacker Stuns the Defender, 1 Buff is Nullified off of both the Attacker and the Defender.
When the Attacker performs the same Combo-Ending Attack twice in a row, the Defender is inflicted with a Falter Debuff for 2 seconds.
The Attacker is inflicted with an indefinite Fumble Passive, unaffected by Ability Accuracy.
The Attacker's Offensive Spirit Gain Rate is increased 50%.
The Defender cannot heal above the amount of Health they started the fight with.
Every time the Attacker performs a successful Well Timed Block, they gain a Passive Disorient, reducing Defensive Ability Accuracy and Block Proficiency by 5% for 15 seconds.
Every time the Attacker performs a successful Well Timed Block, they gain a Passive Disorient, reducing Defensive Ability Accuracy and Block Proficiency by 10% for 15 seconds.
The Defender is 10% more likely to use Heavy Attacks.
The Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks.

Every 5 hits in the attackers Combo Meter creates 1 Steadfast Buff allowing them to block 1 Unblockable hit. Each Steadfast Buff also provides +5% Block Proficiency during the Defenders Special Attacks.
If near the Defender for 4 seconds, the Attacker is Passively Rooted for 4 seconds.

The Defender starts the fight with 1 Limited Opening Charges, and while at 0 Charges they are Immune to Stun effects. 1 Charge is added when Intercepted, and a Charge is removed when a Stun naturally expires off them.
For every 2.20 seconds the Attacker is close to the Defender, the Attacker gains an indefinite 10% Weakness Debuff. Every 2 seconds away from the Defender removes one of these Debuffs.
When the Defender activates a Special Attack, the Attacker generates a fixed 1 Bar of Power, ignoring Power Rate. This is the only way the Attacker can gain Power in this fight.
Interrupting the Defender's Heavy Attack makes them Angry for 6 seconds. Angry Opponents are more aggressive, Passively Unblockable, and have their Defensive Combat Power Rate reduced by 20%.
If the Attacker attempts the same Basic Attack twice in a row the Defender has a 100% chance to Evade the second Attack.
Mutant Attackers: When inflicting a Debuff, there is a 40% chance, plus 20% per Debuff on the Defender, to gain a +30% Prowess Buff until the end of the next Special Attack.
Armor Break Debuffs inflicted on the Defender are 25% more potent, however, the Defender takes 75% less damage from all sources unless they are inflicted with an Armor Break Debuff.

The final hit of the Defender's Special Attacks inflicts an Imminent Death that Knocks Out the Attacker after 6 seconds and cannot be prevented by any means. Performing a Light Combo Ender safely removes Imminent Death.
When the Attacker gains a Bar of Power, they are Special Locked for 1 second.

The Defender's Well-Timed Blocks reduce damage by an additional 25%. If contact is made by Basic Attacks, the Attacker is inflicted with a Stun Debuff for 1 second, increased by up to 1 second with Perfect Block Chance.

Defenders under the effect of Unstoppable become Stun Immune, this includes Unstoppable effects triggered outside this node.\n\nEvery 10 second(s) the Defender gains an Unstoppable buff for 5 second(s). The duration of this buff is reduced by 0.50 second(s) for each Prowess Buff or Passive the Attacker has.
The Defender's Ability Accuracy cannot be reduced.
The Defender is Immune to Power Drain, Power Burn, Power Steal, Power Lock, Special Lock, and Enervate effects.
While the Defender is Unstoppable, they are Stun Immune.
For every 2.20 seconds the Attacker is close to the Defender, the Attacker gains a Placebo Buff for 5 seconds.
Each time the Attacker leaves striking distance, the Defender gains a Power Gain Buff, granting 4% of Max Power per second. When entering striking distance the Buff is removed.

When the Attacker reaches 3 Bars of Power a 3 second timer starts. If they do not activate a Special Attack before it expires, their Power is set to zero and they generate 100% of their Max Power over 6 seconds.
For each Debuff active on the Defender, the Attacker ignores 20% of the damage they would take while striking the Defender, up to a max of 80%.
Whenever the Attacker's Combo Meter reaches 20, or a multiple of 20, the Defender gains a stacking 5 second Unblockable Buff.
Any champion inflicted with a Shock Debuff lands guaranteed Critical Hits for the duration of the Shock Debuff.

If the Attacker hasn't landed a hit in 8 seconds they are inflicted with an indefinite Shock Passive that deals 2% of their Max Health as Energy Damage every second. Striking the Defender removes this Shock and resets the timer.

If the Attacker hasn't landed a hit in 6 seconds they are inflicted with an indefinite Shock Debuff that deals 2% of their Max Health as Energy Damage every second. Striking the Defender removes this Shock and resets the timer.
The Defender takes 90% reduced damage from all sources, except during the Attacker's Special Attacks if they've had a Prowess effect during the Special.
The Attacker's Special Attack 2 deals 50% more damage, but their other Special Attacks deal 50% less damage.
Punishing the Defender's Special Attack grants the Attacker a Grit Passive for 6 seconds, paused during the Attacker's Special Attacks and while the Striker is active.
For the duration of the Defender's Special Attacks, the Attacker is inflicted with a Passive Root or Reverse Controls, starting with Root and cycling whenever the Defender finishes a Special Attack.

Whenever the Defender is Intercepted or their Heavy Attack is Interrupted, they gain an indefinite Fury Passive increasing Attack Rating by 50% of their Base Attack. Upon gaining 5 Fury Passives this way, they are all removed and the Attacker gains a Fury Passive increasing Attack Rating by 200% of their Base Attack for 10 seconds.
